code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows severe hypoxemia and acidemia (low O₂ saturation, low pO₂, low pH), anemia, leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, and abnormal white cell differential (monocytosis, basophilia, neutropenia). INR is markedly elevated, suggesting coagulopathy. Ferritin is high, indicating inflammation or possible iron overload. These findings are consistent with severe respiratory failure, possible sepsis, and disseminated intravascular coagulation (DIC). Immediate clinical attention is warranted.
